reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. Now, when you shape the ground, the water depth updates dynamically without freezing the frame. This means you can dig, raise, and manipulate terrain more smoothly than ever. Check out the full details of these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Overhaul in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce an overhaul of the water mechanics in Provincia! With these updates, water depth now adjusts dynamically to terrain changes without causing frame freezes. This allows for a smoother gameplay experience as you build and shape your city. For more details, visit our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
